arxiv-2101-03367.title: Opportunities of Federated Learning in Connected, Cooperative and Automated Industrial Systems
arxiv-2101-03367.creator: Stefano Savazzi, Monica Nicoli, Mehdi Bennis, Sanaz Kianoush, Luca Barbieri
arxiv-2101-03367.description: Abstract Next-generation autonomous and networked industrial systems (i.e., robots, vehicles, drones) have driven advances in ultra-reliable, low latency communications (URLLC) and computing. These networked multi-agent systems require fast, communication-efficient and distributed machine learning (ML) to provide mission critical control functionalities. Distributed ML techniques, including federated learning (FL), represent a mushrooming multidisciplinary research area weaving in sensing, communication and learning.

arxiv-2104-00741.title: Accretion induced black hole spin up revised by numerical GR MHD simulations
arxiv-2104-00741.creator: Dominika Ł. Król, Agnieszka Janiuk
arxiv-2104-00741.description: Abstract We investigate the accretion induced spin up of the black hole via numerical simulations. Our method is based on general-relativistic magneto-hydrodynamics of the slowly-rotating flows in the Kerr metric, where possibly transonic shock fronts may form. We account for the changing black hole mass and spin during accretion which enforces dynamical evolution of the space-time metric.

arxiv-2304-01933.title: LLM-Adapters: An Adapter Family for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
arxiv-2304-01933.creator: Zhiqiang Hu Lei Wang Yihuai Lan Wanyu Xu Ee-Peng Lim, Lidong Bing Xing Xu Soujanya Poria Roy Ka-Wei Lee
arxiv-2304-01933.description: Abstract The success of large language models (LLMs), like GPT-4 and ChatGPT, has led to the development of numerous cost-effective and accessible alternatives that are created by finetuning open-access LLMs with task-specific data (e.g., ChatDoctor) or instruction data (e.g., Alpaca).

arxiv-2310-12615.title: Network Abstractions for Characterizing Communication Requirements in Asynchronous Distributed Systems
arxiv-2310-12615.creator: Hugo Rincon Galeana, Ulrich Schmid
arxiv-2310-12615.description: Abstract Whereas distributed computing research has been very successful in exploring the solvability/impossibility border of distributed computing problems like consensus in representative classes of computing models with respect to model parameters like failure bounds, this is not the case for characterizing necessary and sufficient communication requirements.

arxiv-2411-10501.title: OnlyFlow: Optical Flow based Motion Conditioning for Video Diffusion Models
arxiv-2411-10501.creator: Mathis Koroglu, Hugo Caselles-Dupré, Guillaume Jeanneret, Matthieu Cord
arxiv-2411-10501.description: Abstract We consider the problem of text-to-video generation tasks with precise control for various applications such as camera movement control and video-to-video editing. Most methods tackling this problem rely on providing user-defined controls, such as binary masks or camera movement embeddings.

arxiv-2412-17158.title: \pkg MOODE: An \proglang R Package for Multi-Objective Optimal Design of Experiments
arxiv-2412-17158.creator: Vasiliki Koutra King’s College London, Olga Egorova King’s College London, Steven G. Gilmour King’s College London, Luzia A. Trinca São Paulo State University
arxiv-2412-17158.description: Abstract \Plainauthor Vasiliki Koutra, Olga Egorova, Steven G. Gilmour, Luzia A. Trinca \Plaintitle MOODE: An R Package for Multi-Objective Optimal Design of Experiments \Shorttitle \pkg MOODE: Multi-Objective Optimal Design of Experiments \Abstract We describe the \proglang R package \pkg MOODE and demonstrate its use to find multi-objective optimal experimental designs.

arxiv-2502-10193.title: Merging public elementary schools to reduce racial/ethnic segregation
arxiv-2502-10193.creator: Madison Landry, Nabeel Gillani
arxiv-2502-10193.description: Abstract Diverse schools can help address implicit biases and increase empathy, mutual respect, and reflective thought by fostering connections between students from different racial/ethnic, socioeconomic, and other backgrounds. Unfortunately, demographic segregation remains rampant in US public schools, despite over 70 years since the passing of federal legislation formally outlawing segregation by race.

arxiv-2505-17591.title: MinkUNeXt-SI: Improving point cloud-based place recognition including spherical coordinates and LiDAR intensity
arxiv-2505-17591.creator: Judith Vilella-Cantos, Juan José Cabrera, Luis Payá, Mónica Ballesta, David Valiente
arxiv-2505-17591.description: Abstract In autonomous navigation systems, the solution of the place recognition problem is crucial for their safe functioning. But this is not a trivial solution, since it must be accurate regardless of any changes in the scene, such as seasonal changes and different weather conditions, and it must be generalizable to other environments.

arxiv-2506-08079.title: Hydrostatic and explosive α \alpha -element chemical abundances of Milky Way globular clusters, halo substructures, and satellite galaxies 2025 Hydrostatic and explosive α \alpha -element chemical abundances of Milky Way globular clusters, halo substructures, and satellite galaxies – References
arxiv-2506-08079.creator: Danny Horta, Melissa K. Ness
arxiv-2506-08079.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Danny Horta, Melissa K. Ness. Stellar atmospheric element abundance ratios of stars retain information about their birth conditions, helping elucidate their origin and nature. In this letter, we analyse and contrast the hydrostatic and explosive α \alpha -element abundance ratios, and the ratio of the two (the hex ratio), for a large sample of Galactic globular clusters (GCs), halo substructures, satellite galaxies, and the Milky Way high-/low- α \alpha discs using data from the APOGEE survey.

arxiv-2508-13253.title: Automated Cervical Cancer Detection through Visual Inspection with Acetic Acid in Resource-Poor Settings with Lightweight Deep Learning Models Deployed on an Android Device
arxiv-2508-13253.creator: Leander Melroy Maben, Keerthana Prasad, Shyamala Guruvare, Vidya Kudva, P C Siddalingaswamy
arxiv-2508-13253.description: Abstract Cervical cancer is among the most commonly occurring cancer among women and claims a huge number of lives in low and middle-income countries despite being relatively easy to treat. Several studies have shown that public screening programs can bring down cervical cancer incidence and mortality rates significantly.

arxiv-2508-15167.title: Multiple nodal solutions to a scalar field equation with double-power nonlinearity and zero mass at infinity
arxiv-2508-15167.creator: Mónica Clapp, Carlos Culebro
arxiv-2508-15167.description: Abstract We consider the nonlinear elliptic equation − Δ ​ u + V ⁡ ( x ) ​ u = f ⁡ ( u ) , u ∈ D 0 1 , 2 ​ ( Ω ) , -\Delta u+V(x)u=f(u),\qquad u\in D^{1,2}_{0}(\Omega), in an exterior domain Ω \Omega of ℝ N \mathbb{R}^{N} , where V V is a scalar potential

arxiv-2509-08010.title: Measuring and mitigating overreliance is necessary for building human-compatible AI Thanks: Currently at Apple
arxiv-2509-08010.creator: Lujain Ibrahim, Katherine M. Collins, Sunnie S. Y. Kim, Anka Reuel, Max Lamparth, Kevin Feng, Lama Ahmad, Prajna Soni, Alia El Kattan, Merlin Stein, Siddharth Swaroop, Ilia Sucholutsky, Andrew Strait, Q. Vera Liao, Umang Bhatt
arxiv-2509-08010.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) distinguish themselves from previous technologies by functioning as collaborative “thought partners,” capable of engaging more fluidly in natural language. As LLMs increasingly influence consequential decisions across diverse domains from healthcare to personal advice, the risk of overreliance — relying on LLMs beyond their capabilities — grows.

arxiv-2602-22313.title: Quantum simulation of massive Thirring and Gross–Neveu models for arbitrary number of flavors
arxiv-2602-22313.creator: Bojko N. Bakalov, João C. Getelina, Raghav G. Jha, Alexander F. Kemper, Yuan Liu
arxiv-2602-22313.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Bojko N. Bakalov, João C. Getelina, Raghav G. Jha, Alexander F. Kemper, Yuan Liu. The study of fermionic quantum field theories is an important problem for realizing the standard model of particle physics on a quantum computer. As a step towards this goal, we consider the massive Thirring and Gross–Neveu models with arbitrary number of fermion flavors, N f N_{f} , discretized on a spatial one-dimensional lattice of size L L in the Hamiltonian formulation.

arxiv-2606-02690.title: Speed and accuracy for long signals: Frequency-domain effective-one-body waveforms for compact binary coalescences
arxiv-2606-02690.creator: Marcus Haberland 1, Alessandra Buonanno 1,2

britannica-1911-wallace-lewis.title: Wallace, Lewis (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-wallace-lewis.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-wallace-lewis.description: Article 'Wallace, Lewis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. author, was born at Brookville, Indiana, on the 10th of April 1827, and received an academic education. He abandoned temporarily the study of law in Indianapolis to recruit a company of volunteers (of which he was made second lieutenant) for the Mexican War, and served in 1846–1847 in the First Indiana Battery.

cia-0000104916.source: Internet Archive — CIA Reading Room mirror
cia-0000104916.description: Declassified CIA document 0000104916, dated 5 May 1985. Subject: INDIA: A GROWING ROLE IN TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER.

pmc-11472348.title: Complete Active Space Iterative Coupled Cluster Theory
pmc-11472348.creator: Robin Feldmann, Maximilian Mörchen, Jakub Lang, Michał Lesiuk, Markus Reiher
pmc-11472348.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this work, we investigate the possibility of improving multireference-driven coupled cluster (CC) approaches with an algorithm that iteratively combines complete active space (CAS) calculations with tailored CC and externally corrected CC. This is accomplished by establishing a feedback loop between the CC and CAS parts of a calculation through a similarity transformation of the Hamiltonian with those CC amplitudes that are not encompassed by the active space. We denote this approach as the complete active space iterative coupled cluster (CASiCC) ansatz.

pmc-11506986.title: Quantum-Like Approaches Unveil the Intrinsic Limits of Predictability in Compartmental Models
pmc-11506986.creator: José Alejandro Rojas-Venegas, Pablo Gallarta-Sáenz, Rafael G Hurtado, Jesús Gómez-Gardeñes, David Soriano-Paños, José María Amigó, Fernando Montani
pmc-11506986.description: Obtaining accurate forecasts for the evolution of epidemic outbreaks from deterministic compartmental models represents a major theoretical challenge. Recently, it has been shown that these models typically exhibit trajectory degeneracy, as different sets of epidemiological parameters yield comparable predictions at early stages of the outbreak but disparate future epidemic scenarios.

pmc-11539430.title: Analysis of genetic diversity and genetic structure of indigenous chicken populations in Guizhou province based on genome-wide single nucleotide polymorphism markers
pmc-11539430.creator: Sheng Wu, Zhiwen Chen, Xiaohong Zhou, Juanhong Lu, Yingping Tian, Yaozhou Jiang, Qinsong Liu, Zhong Wang, Hui Li, Lujiang Qu, Fuping Zhang
pmc-11539430.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Guizhou province in China is rich in indigenous chicken breeds, playing an essential role in the genetic improvement of modern chickens. Genetic diversity has decreased in recent decades due to accelerated breeding processes and changing conservation priorities. To determine the genetic diversity and population structure of Guizhou indigenous chicken breeds, we used 55K genotyping arrays to conduct population genetic analysis on 233 individuals from 8 Guizhou indigenous breeds and 263 individuals from 9 Guizhou indigenous chicken populations.

pmc-11585477.title: Aggregating amyloid resources: A comprehensive review of databases on amyloid-like aggregation
pmc-11585477.creator: Valentín Iglesias, Jarosław Chilimoniuk, Carlos Pintado-Grima, Oriol Bárcenas, Salvador Ventura, Michał Burdukiewicz
pmc-11585477.description: Protein aggregation is responsible for several degenerative conditions in humans, and it is also a bottleneck in industrial protein production and storage of biotherapeutics. Bioinformatics tools have been developed to predict and redesign protein solubility more efficiently by understanding the underlying principles behind aggregation.

pmc-11633468.title: Hepatocyte‐Targeted Lipid Nanoparticle Delivery of HERC2 Plasmid Controls Drug‐Induced Hepatotoxicity by Limiting β‐Catenin‐Regulated CYP2E1 Expression
pmc-11633468.creator: Yunzhi Liu, Qishan Xu, Yan Liu, Sihang Cao, Jialiang Luo, Zhuojun Zheng, Jia Zhou, Xiao Lu, Liyun Zhang, Yanan Tan, Qingyun Chen, Daming Zuo
pmc-11633468.description: Understanding the molecular mechanisms that bridge hepatic inflammation and liver injury is crucial for developing effective therapeutic strategies for drug‐induced liver injury (DILI) management. HECT domain and RCC1‐like domain 2 (HERC2) belongs to the large Herc family of ubiquitin E3 ligases, which are implicated in tissue development and inflammation.

pmc-12039838.title: Lateral thinking: Neurodegeneration of the cortical cholinergic system in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-12039838.creator: Rachel A. Crockett, Charlotte Casselton, Tatianna M. Howard, Kevin B. Wilkins, Gang Seo, Helen M. Brontë-Stewart
pmc-12039838.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction:Atrophy of the nucleus basalis of Meynert (NBM) is an early indicator of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). However, reduced integrity of the NBM white matter tracts may be more relevant for cognitive impairment and progression to dementia than NBM volume.

pmc-12531914.title: Structural brain correlates of neuropsychomotor performance in older adults with early cognitive decline
pmc-12531914.creator: Haewon Byeon
pmc-12531914.description: This letter critically evaluates the study by Yue et al investigating the association between gray matter volume (GMV) and cognitive/motor function in amnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI). Yue et al utilized voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and comprehensive functional assessments, finding significant GMV reductions in aMCI patients compared to controls, notably in temporal, parietal, occipital, and frontal regions.

pmc-12583487.title: JMJD3 upregulates ALOX5 to drive malignancy and concomitant ferroptosis sensitivity in gastric cancer
pmc-12583487.creator: Gege Shu, Jiaoyang Yang, Huifang Hu, Anqi Dong, Tao Chen, Weikang Li, Xiaotong Sun, Peiyuan Li, Pengbo Wang, Changshun Shao, Jin Zhou
pmc-12583487.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chemotherapy remains the cornerstone of gastric cancer (GC) treatment, with Oxaliplatin (OXA) being a critical first-line agent. However, chemotherapy resistance, compounded by increased stemness, poses a significant challenge in GC management. In this study, we demonstrate that JMJD3, encoded by KDM6B and catalyzing the demethylation of H3K27me3, is highly expressed in both GC tissues and patient-derived chemotherapy-resistant xenograft (PDX) models and contributes to increased malignancy and chemoresistance.

pmc-13023612.title: Liquid-Gated Field-Effect Transistor-Based Biosensor for Uric Acid Detection
pmc-13023612.creator: Rafiq Ahmad, Abdullah, Altaf Khan, Fohad Mabood Husain, Byeong-Il Lee
pmc-13023612.description: Monitoring uric acid (UA) concentration is crucial for human health, enabling early detection and prevention of metabolic disorders as well as assessing renal function and overall metabolic balance. Herein, we developed a field-effect transistor (FET)-based UA biosensor using hydrothermally synthesized vertical zinc oxide (ZnO) nanorods (NRs) and uricase.

pmc-13409843.title: Perceptions of Change in Depression Among Participants in a Program Based on Permission Theory
pmc-13409843.creator: Fernanda Dias Alves, Jacqueline de Torres Boesso, Renato Pereira de Torres, Elton Euler da Silva Reis
pmc-13409843.description: Background: Depression is a major public health concern and remains a challenge despite traditional care approaches. This study sought to answer the following research question: how do participants in a program based on Permission Theory describe their perceptions of change related to the depressive experience?

pmc-13415402.title: Coupled Thermal and Nonlocal Effects in Advanced Composite Nanobeams: An Efficient Higher-Order Modeling Approach
pmc-13415402.creator: Rabab A. Alghanmi, Mohammed Sid Ahmed Houari
pmc-13415402.description: The present research proposes a mathematical method to examine the combined impacts of thermal loading and nonlocal elasticity on the dynamic behavior of functionally graded (FG) nanobeams. A refined higher-order shear deformation theory is introduced, featuring an enhanced displacement field with integral unknowns and a hyperbolic thickness-dependent function to accurately capture transverse shear strains without shear correction constants.

pmc-13456739.title: Assessing the association of healthy lifestyle indicators (life’s simple 7) with bacterial vaginosis in reproductive-age women: A cross-sectional analysis of a nationwide survey
pmc-13456739.creator: Yang Feng, Xiaoqian Zhang

pmc-13645650.title: Vitamin K and vascular calcification: from biological plausibility to clinical realism
pmc-13645650.creator: Vincent Brandenburg, Nikolaus Keil, Thilo Krüger, Hermann Salmhofer, Turgay Saritas
pmc-13645650.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Vitamin K has long been considered a potentially protective factor against ectopic calcification. This review summarizes the biological rationale and randomized clinical evidence for vitamin K supplementation as an anti-calcification strategy, with particular emphasis on chronic kidney disease. The concept is biologically plausible because vitamin K is required for post-translational γ-carboxylation and activation of matrix Gla protein, a key endogenous inhibitor of vascular and valvular calcification.
